high_level_description: This image depicts a serene coastal scene featuring a wooden boardwalk extending towards the ocean. The boardwalk is flanked by railings on both sides, with decorative elements such as pelican statues and small lanterns mounted on poles. The pelicans are positioned symmetrically at the ends of the boardwalk, adding a touch of charm to the setting. The ocean is visible in the background, with gentle waves lapping against the shore. The sky above is overcast, with a mix of gray clouds suggesting a calm but possibly cool day.
